request.system: You are a sceptical results reviewer. Task: rank Medicare providers for audit. Each of 5,410 providers carries a PotentialFraud label (9.35% flagged) whose origin is undocumented; treat it as suspicion, not confirmed fraud. Claims run 27 Nov 2008 to 31 Dec 2009. The primary metric is PR-AUC; the audit queue holds about 100 providers. Pick the configuration to carry forward. Prefer a simpler model unless a more complex one is better by more than one standard deviation of PR-AUC across folds. Flag any result that looks too good. You may request up to 2 more round(s) of experiments; set stop=true if further search is unlikely to help. (Independent run 1, no feature agent.)

concerns: Run 1 (LightGBM, all) has the best PR-AUC at 0.7346, but its edge over logistic run 3 (0.6925) is 0.042, below one SD (0.057-0.068). By the simplicity rule, logistic run 3 is chosen.
Folds are noisy, with SD about 0.06-0.07 on all runs. Differences between all four configurations fall within noise, so further tuning is unlikely to help.

Logistic with C=0.1 and class_weight, ROC-AUC about 0.94 on all four runs and precision@50 of 0.76-0.77 are strikingly high for fraud labels of unknown origin. Models may be reproducing the labelling rule or a proxy such as provider size or claim volume, rather than detecting fraud.

The 'size' family (13 features) is a likely proxy. Dropping it (no_size) barely changes results, which suggests the signal is spread across other families that may encode the label origin, such as money, intensity and patient_mix.
The label is treated as suspicion, not confirmed fraud. High PR-AUC only shows agreement with that label, not audit yield.
It is unclear whether the CV was stratified or grouped. The claims window runs 27 Nov 2008 to 31 Dec 2009, and there is no temporal holdout, so drift and leakage cannot be ruled out.
Precision@50 is used as a proxy for the queue of about 100, and precision@100 is not reported. With about 506 positives, a queue of 100 is a small slice, so the estimate is noisy.
Agent features are unavailable, so the comparison is limited to the base features.
